description: Generates a video from text at up to 4K (Seedance 2.0 Mini).

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio of the output video. Default 16:9 deviates from node.py (required combo) — declarative L2 default for canonical/MCP callers.

duration.description: Duration of the output video in seconds (4-15).

seed.description: Seed controls whether the node should re-run; results are non-deterministic regardless of seed.

dispatch_mode.description: Dispatch mode. "sync" (default) blocks until the job completes. "async" submits the job and returns immediately with a job ID; poll completion via `job_get`. Named `dispatch_mode` (not bare `mode`) so it never collides with provider-specific `mode` knobs (freepik DynamicCombo, pixverse motion mode, meshy pose mode, …).

generate_audio.description: Enable audio generation for the output video.

resolution.description: Resolution of the output video. "Seedance 2.0 Fast" supports 480p/720p only; 1080p is rejected at parse time. Default 720p deviates from node.py (which surfaces this as a required combo widget) — declarative L2 default for canonical/MCP callers.

watermark.description: Whether to add a watermark to the video.
